column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, a release asset, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# The one published build is the rolling dev pre-release, 0.0.0-nightly.20260826.f3e1875, built
# from f3e1875. There is no v* release and no predecessor repo. The oracle is
# Configuration/PluginConfig.cs at f3e1875 byte for byte, and it uses no core code. The reader in
# src/ShadowsOfDoubtHeadTracking/Legacy was frozen from the file at c631db6, which differs from
# f3e1875's only in taking five defaults (LimitX 0.30, LimitZ 0.40, LimitZBack 0.10, LocalSmoothing
# 0, RemoteSmoothing 0.15) from core's constants of the same values (91cc94e); the frozen reader
# holds them as literals, restructured to fill LegacyConfig and write nothing.

BepInEx 6
# BepInEx 6.0.0-be.785. The test, and the first-run harness below, ran its BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Core.dll
# (sha256 352aacc2d5356489a00891f76db28b6463c81d25bcb02f90035171a669b7e35b), which the game loads.
# No published build shipped the plugin .cfg, in its ZIP or as a launcher-manifest.json seed, so the
# input is what the build writes at its first start: the .cfg its own ShadowsOfDoubtHeadTracking.dll,
# taken from the dev pre-release's installer ZIP (the ZIP's SHA-256 checked against the digest GitHub
# reports for the asset), writes when its PluginConfig.Initialize runs on a ConfigFile at a path with
# no file and the plugin's BepInPlugin metadata (com.headtracking.shadowsofdoubt, Head Tracking, 0.0.0,
# read from the DLL), as BasePlugin builds it. It ran on .NET 6.0.36 with that BepInEx.Core.dll and the
# UnityEngine.CoreModule of the UnityEngine.Modules 2021.3.45 package the DLL was built against. The
# "Acceptable values" comment lines list whichever KeyCode enum the harness loaded; in game they list
# the one the game's interop assemblies hold. No reader reads a comment line.
